motion.name: duration-normal
motion.purpose: Panels and overlays entering; 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one action a view asks for; accent fill, label in accent-text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: var(--cc-control-h); padding: 0 var(--cc-control-px); border: 0; border-radius: var(--cc-radius-md); background: var(--cc-accent); color: var(--cc-accent-text); font: 500 var(--cc-font-size-sm)/1.5 var(--cc-font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color var(--cc-duration-fast) var(--cc-ease-out); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--cc-accent-hover); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cc-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Raised field with a 3:1 boundary; the ring takes the accent on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: var(--cc-control-h); padding: 0 var(--cc-control-px); border: 1px solid var(--cc-border-strong); border-radius: var(--cc-radius-md); background: var(--cc-surface-raised); color: var(--cc-text); font: 400 var(--cc-font-size-md)/1.5 var(--cc-font-sans); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--cc-text-muted); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cc-focus); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status text on its soft tint; colour never carries the meaning alone.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: var(--cc-space-1) var(--cc-space-2); border-radius: var(--cc-radius-pill); background: var(--cc-danger-soft); color: var(--cc-danger); font: 500 var(--cc-font-size-xs)/1.5 var(--cc-font-sans); }

narrative.overview: Every CodeCora product stands on the same frame: the same structure, spacing, states, keyboard behaviour and contrast floor. A theme is the face on that frame: colour, fonts, radius, density and icon weight. Themes mix per element, so a dark corin panel can sit inside a light uteke page and both stay correct.
keyCharacteristics: Semantic tokens only (`--cc-surface`, `--cc-text`, `--cc-accent`, ...); components never see a raw colour.
One accent per scope, chosen with `data-accent`; status colours carry meaning, never decoration.
Two densities, `comfortable` (44px controls) and `compact` (32px), switched with `data-density`.
Flat surfaces separated by tone; shadows are reserved for floating layers.

rules.name: The Semantic Only Rule
rules.body: Components read `--cc-*` tokens and nothing else. A raw colour outside `packages/tokens` is a defect.

rules.name: The Meaning Before Hue Rule
rules.body: Accent means "act here" or "you are here"; status colours mean their status. Neither decorates.

rules.name: The AA Floor Rule
rules.body: Every theme and accent passes WCAG 2.2 AA for the pairs listed in the tokens README; `bun run contrast` and the unit tests enforce it.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: IDs, dates, counts and any number that changes use the mono family with tabular figures.

rules.name: The Tone Before Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separate resting surfaces with surface tokens; use a shadow only when something floats.

dos: **Do** set `data-theme` on the element that should change, not on every child.
**Do** use `border-strong` wherever the border is the only cue that a control exists.
donts: **Don't** write a colour literal in a component, a playground page or an app override.
**Don't** rely on colour alone to show state or meaning.
**Don't** add product-specific tokens to a shared theme; a product theme carries them.
